I'm unsure about how things work with a Drawing out the beast and
a inferior Terror Frenzy played in the same combat against the same
vampire.
Say, i play first a Dotb, next (same combat) i play, against the same
vamp, an inferior Terror Frenzy.
What happens?

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 18 Apr 2000 21:48:00 GMT, tetragr...@my-deja.com wrote:

>I'm unsure about how things work with a Drawing out the beast and
>a inferior Terror Frenzy played in the same combat against the same
>vampire.
>Say, i play first a Dotb, next (same combat) i play, against the same
>vamp, an inferior Terror Frenzy.
>What happens?

He can't maneuver at all. He can use things like Shadow Step to set
range whereever he wants, but since Terror Frenzy prevents him from
using maneuvers to set to close range, and Drawing out the Beast
prevents him from using a maneuver except to cancel another, he's
basically stuck. (The only maneuver possible in the combat would be
played by you, to maneuver to long range. Since he can't come back to
close by Terror Frenzy and you can't re-maneuver to close to provide
him a maneuver he CAN cancel, he's stuck with Shadow Step and the
like, OR just stuck at long range.)

-- Derek
